plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.chinese: 为网页和应用设计并实现前端界面。

steps: Registered a local checkout of the pinned upstream marketplace and installed frontend-design through the packaged desktop server.
Read the installed frontend-design skill through Stodex, disabled it, enabled it again, and then uninstalled it.
verified.result: The skill instructions resolved after installation and re-enabling. The skill disappeared after disabling and uninstalling.
